The pavé chocolate is really delicious. Pavé chocolate is the best. I always make sure to order the pavé chocolate and try a different other item each time, but I always, always order the pavé chocolate.

reviews.english: This was my first time ordering from here, and as you'd expect from a chocolate specialty shop, the flavor is luxurious. The Dubai butter tteok in particular was really delicious: even the bread on its own was nutty and fragrant, with a chocolate flavor. The pistachio sauce that comes with it is more than the amount of filling in most Dubai chewy cookies, and it really tastes of the pistachios themselves; it's moderately sweet and very delicious. It's been a long time since I've had desserts this good, so I think I'll become a regular!! The complimentary granola bar was really delicious too. I don't like chocolate that tastes strongly of palm oil, but this place uses real chocolate. It's really luxurious and delicious. I'll order again next time~
